## 🚀 Background Description

Issue #817 defined four acceptance criteria across three CI engineering capabilities: test coverage gating, CI stability, and release CI efficiency (`<5h`). Three pull requests have since landed on `main`:

- **PR #951** (`2c33bc5017`): migrated 11 previously unscheduled Playwright specs (41 case identities) onto the shared PR plan (`L2` mocked E2E) and removed the `legacy` Playwright project (`status:legacy`, `ci:e2e:legacy`, `test:legacy*`, `CI_ALLOW_LEGACY`).
- **PR #940** (`360e6b664f`): preserved `reasoning_effort: low` across Evolve and search paths, added bounded upstream transport retries (502/503/504/524 and mid-stream socket resets) for streaming model completions, and configured Nightly model and judge calls to run with `low` effort in `nightly-research` with a 75-minute research-team timeout.
- **PR #971** (`1db615cdd2`): narrowed the active BiomniBench-DA L5 execution set from 50 to 45 cases (64 total real L5 cases), pinned Biomni generator and rubric judge thinking to `enabled` with `low` effort, scaled additive resource baselines by `45/50`, and recovered `da-11-1` when a stream ends cleanly inside truncated tool-call JSON.

### Audit of #817 Acceptance Criteria on Current `main`

Measured against the latest completed `main` CI run [42968972446](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/42968972446) (`679038182e`) and recent L5 / Release runs:

#### 1. Coverage thresholds and gating
- **1.1 Coverage gate enforcement**: **Not met** — `scripts/coverage-job-summary.mjs` and `.ci/tier-policy.mjs` remain informational only (`Coverage is informational. No minimum percentage is enforced`), and the Coverage job still merges only `ut` and `st` (mocked browser E2E is not measured).
- **1.2 Whole-repo line coverage ≥80%**: **Met** — **80.82%** (`203,344 / 251,596`; Node.js `81.18%`, Python `73.93%`, up from the `73.11%` baseline at `6d3c49a`).
- **1.3 Whole-repo branch coverage ≥70%**: **Not met** — **59.86%** (`98,788 / 165,035`; Node.js `59.80%`, Python `62.06%`), **10.14 percentage points** below the `70%` target.
- **1.4 Function coverage ≥80%**: **Met (Node.js)** — **80.08%** (`13,142 / 16,411`; Python function coverage is not separately reported).
- **1.5 Statement coverage ≥80%**: **Not implemented** — `summary.json` reports `lines`, `branches`, and `functions` only.
- **1.6 New / changed code (PR diff) coverage ≥80%**: **Not implemented** — no PR diff coverage calculation, summary comment, or gate check exists in CI.
- **1.7 Per-package coverage floor ≥60%**: **Partially met** — `apps/web` (`62.89%`) and Node `services/runner` (`88.55%`) now exceed `60%`, while `packages/idea-tree` (`45.94%`), `packages/schema` (`57.89%`), and Python `services/runner` (`0%`) remain below `60%`.
- **1.8 Core-path coverage ≥90%**: **Partially met** — `services/api` (`94.84%`), `packages/sandbox-capability` (`100%`), and `packages/model` (`96.48%`) exceed `90%` line coverage, while `services/gateway` (`75.23%`) and `services/runner` (`88.55%`) are below `90%`, and no dedicated core-path gate is enforced.

#### 2. Case-level profile and module coverage
- **2.1 No case outside every profile**: **Partially met** — PR #951 eliminated all 42 `status:legacy` dead cases by moving 41 valid browser identities into the `pr` (`L2`) profile. Remaining cases outside `test/support/tagged/profiles.mjs` rules are 79 `status:external` UT/ST cases, 1 `status:quarantined` case (`test/literature-review.spec.ts`), 1 `npu:required` case, 1 `category:st + model:real` case, and 6 `os:macos` cases; `ci:catalog:check` does not yet fail on profile-unreachable tags.
- **2.2 Every module mapped to an executing gating case**: **Not implemented** — the tagged catalog does not yet carry an explicit case-to-module ownership mapping or fail when a module has no executing case.

#### 3. CI stability and flake governance
- **3.1 Automated flake identification and quarantine**: **Not implemented** — no rolling failure-rate detector, automatic quarantine transition, or tracking-issue workflow is in place.
- **3.2 Infrastructure-only retries for network/gateway faults**: **Partially met** — PR #940 and PR #971 implemented bounded transport/stream retries and clean-EOF tool-argument recovery without retrying product defects, but per-case infrastructure retry counts and gateway-outage separation are not yet surfaced in the CI summary.
- **3.3 Thinking-mode (`low` / off) A/B experiment and CI configuration**: **Partially met** — PR #940 and PR #971 pinned Nightly and Biomni L5 runs to `reasoning_effort: low` without changing product defaults, while a formal multi-run A/B pass-rate and variance comparison report remains open.

#### 4. Release CI efficiency (`<5h`)
- **4.1 L5 release CI end-to-end duration <5 hours**: **Not met** — after PR #971 landed, the `main` L5 run [42380603816](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/42380603816) (`l5 · parallel=4 · nightly-research`) ran for **15h 39m** (2026-11-07 14:13Z to 2026-11-08 05:52Z, failed); prior branch L5 runs [42340397412](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/42340397412) and [42236770100](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/42236770100) took **8h 49m** and **7h 30m**; the latest `Release` workflow run [41196686771](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/41196686771) took **25h 01m**.
- **4.2 In-pipeline duration budget tracking and over-budget alerts**: **Not implemented** — no 5-hour budget table or alert check is wired into `release.yml` or `ci.yml`.
- **4.3 Bulk data downloads managed via cache/prefetch with zero redundant downloads on cache hit**: **Not implemented** — bulk downloads across jobs are not yet uniformly cached/prefetched and timed against the budget.
- **4.4 Real-model journeys running at lowest thinking effort with latency gain recorded**: **Partially met** — `low` effort is active for Nightly and Biomni L5, but before/after per-case p50/p95 latency gain reports have not been published.

---

### Scope of Follow-up Work Tracked by This Issue

Based on the audit above, the following four deliverables require continued development:

1. **Whole-repo branch coverage ≥70% (Item 1.3)**: raise combined Node.js + Python branch coverage from the current **59.86%** (`98,788 / 165,035`) to **≥70%**, and enforce the threshold in CI.
2. **New / changed code (PR diff) coverage ≥80% (Item 1.6)**: compute diff coverage on pull requests against the merge base and enforce a **≥80%** diff coverage gate on executable changed lines/branches in CI.
3. **L5 release CI end-to-end duration <5 hours (Item 4.1)**: reduce full L5 release pipeline wall-clock duration to **<5 hours**, with per-job budget accounting and over-budget alerts in the pipeline summary.
4. **Cache/prefetch management for all bulk data downloads with zero redundant downloads on cache hit (Item 4.3)**: audit and cache/prefetch all bulk downloads in CI (JiuwenSwarm ~1.5 GB runtime and virtualenvs, pnpm/uv dependencies, benchmark datasets and fixtures, model/sidecar assets, and container/base images), record download duration separately, and eliminate repeat bulk downloads when caches hit.

## Design Ideas

1. **Whole-repo branch coverage ≥70%**:
   - Prioritize packages with the largest uncovered branch mass in `coverage/summary.json` and `coverage/python/summary.json` (such as `services/api` at `54.79%` branches, `packages/workspace` at `55.72%`, `packages/artifact-manager` at `56.63%`, `services/gateway` at `57.22%`, `services/memory-graph` at `56.95%`, and `apps/web` at `70.73%`).
   - Add targeted unit and system tests for error branches, boundary guards, and fallback paths, and wire the `≥70%` branch threshold into `scripts/coverage-report.mjs` / `.ci/tier-policy.mjs`.

2. **PR diff coverage ≥80%**:
   - Extend `scripts/coverage-report.mjs` (or add a dedicated diff-coverage step in the `Coverage` job) to intersect `git diff <base>...<head>` hunk lines with merged LCOV / JSON coverage records from Node.js (`ut` + `st`) and Python (`coverage.py`).
   - Publish a clear per-file diff coverage table in `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY` and fail the `Coverage` / `merge-gate` check when changed executable lines fall below `80%`.

3. **L5 release CI end-to-end duration <5 hours**:
   - Add per-job wall-clock and phase timing (setup/download vs. execution) to the L5 summary and enforce a `<5h` (`18,000s`) end-to-end budget check.
   - Combine shard parallelism tuning, long-tail case timeout/step-budget tightening, and deduplication of overlapping lower-tier work in the release profile so the end-to-end critical path stays under 5 hours.

4. **Bulk data download caching and prefetching**:
   - Inventory every multi-hundred-megabyte download across `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `real-e2e.yml`, and `release.yml` (JiuwenSwarm bundle and Python virtualenvs, Node/pnpm stores, benchmark datasets/fixtures, browser binaries, and Docker layers).
   - Key caches by lockfile/manifest content hashes, warm them once in an upstream setup step or shared cache entry, and log cache-hit status plus download byte/time metrics in each job summary so cache-hit runs perform zero redundant bulk downloads.

## Involved Public APIs

None. All changes are internal to CI workflows, coverage reporting/gating scripts, and test suites; no product HTTP, CLI, or SDK APIs are added or modified.

## Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.github/workflows/real-e2e.yml`, `.github/workflows/release.yml`: coverage gating, bulk-download cache orchestration, and L5 duration budget reporting.
- `scripts/coverage-report.mjs`, `scripts/coverage-job-summary.mjs`, `.ci/tier-policy.mjs`: whole-repo branch coverage gate (`≥70%`) and PR diff coverage calculation/gate (`≥80%`).
- `packages/*`, `services/*`, `apps/*` test suites: branch coverage additions to lift whole-repo branch coverage from `59.86%` to `≥70%`.

## Test Design and Test Plan

- **Branch coverage ≥70%**: run `pnpm test:shared` with coverage enabled and `node scripts/coverage-report.mjs`; verify merged whole-repo branch coverage is `≥70.00%` and that lowering the threshold or dropping coverage causes the gate script unit tests to fail.
- **PR diff coverage ≥80%**: add unit tests for the diff-coverage calculator covering added, modified, deleted, and non-executable files, plus a synthetic PR diff below and above `80%` to verify both the step summary table and non-zero exit code on failure.
- **L5 <5h and bulk download caching**: verify on consecutive CI / L5 runs that cache-hit jobs report `cache-hit: true` with near-zero download time for JiuwenSwarm, dependencies, and datasets, that the pipeline summary outputs the job timing breakdown against the 5-hour budget, and that the end-to-end L5 run completes in `<5 hours`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Merged whole-repo branch coverage (`Node.js + Python` across `ut` + `st`) reaches **≥70.00%** (up from `59.86%`), and the CI coverage gate fails if whole-repo branch coverage drops below `70%`.
- [ ] Pull request CI computes diff coverage on changed executable lines against the PR base and fails the gate when PR diff coverage is below **80.00%**, with the per-file diff breakdown rendered in the job summary.
- [ ] All bulk data downloads in CI (JiuwenSwarm install and virtualenvs, pnpm/uv dependencies, benchmark datasets/fixtures, and runtime assets) are managed through content-addressed cache/prefetch steps, download duration is measured separately, and cache-hit runs perform zero redundant bulk downloads.
- [ ] The L5 release CI pipeline finishes end-to-end in **<5 hours** (`<300 minutes`) and publishes a per-job duration vs. budget summary with automatic over-budget alerting.
- Commands that must pass: `pnpm ci:l1` and `pnpm test:shared`.

## Additional Information

- Parent tracking issue: #817
- Related merged PRs: #940, #951, #971
- Reference CI runs audited:
  - `main` coverage run: [42968972446](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/42968972446) (`679038182e`)
  - L5 runs: [42380603816](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/42380603816) (`15h 39m`), [42340397412](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/42340397412) (`8h 49m`), [42236770100](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/42236770100) (`7h 30m`)
  - Release run: [41196686771](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/41196686771) (`25h 01m`)

### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象**：打开 Evolve（evolve 功能扩展）创建对话框，开启「自定义 JSON 与修改范围」后，在「起始字段」区域点击右上角「生成起始字段」没有任何反应：不进入「正在生成…」、不报错、字段列表也不会被填充；「上传 JSON」则工作正常。

**复现步骤**
1. 进入一个会话，在输入框写入一个可度量的任务
2. 触发 evolve 功能扩展，弹出创建对话框
3. 打开「自定义 JSON 与修改范围」开关，滚动到「起始字段」
4. 点击右上角「生成起始字段」
5. 实际：无任何变化（无 loading、无 toast、无错误提示）；期望：按钮进入「正在生成…」，成功后填入可勾选的起始字段

**定位与分析（main，2026-11-11）**
- 按钮实际处于 disabled：`disabled={busy || !onGenerate}`，并且 `generate()` 开头就是 `if (!onGenerate || busy) return;`（apps/desktop/src/views/evolve/DirectionInput.tsx），所以点击被静默吞掉，没有任何 UI 反馈。
- 但 apps/desktop/src/styles/evolve.css 里 `.evolve-json-tools button` 没有 `:disabled` 规则，仍保留 `cursor: pointer`，禁用态与可用态外观完全一致（截图里按钮看起来就是可点的）。
- `onGenerate` 只在会话 detail 已加载时才提供：apps/desktop/src/App.tsx 中 `onGenerateEvolveDirection: state.detail ? (task, signal) => draftEvolveDirection(client, state.detail.id, task, signal) : undefined`。
- 提示文案「先在会话输入框写下任务，即可生成起始字段。」只在 `onGenerate` 为 undefined 时渲染，但它实际缺失的条件不只是「没写任务」，还可能是会话 detail 尚未加载、已归档或只读，导致提示与真实原因不一致：用户按提示写了任务，按钮依旧点不动。

**预期行为**
- 禁用态有可见样式，并说明为什么不可用；或者按钮保持可点，点击时按真实原因给出提示。
- 提示文案按真实原因区分（未写任务 / 会话未就绪 / 只读）。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 应用：ScienceDiscovery 桌面版（Windows x64）
- 系统：Windows 11 专业版 25H2（10.0.26200）
- 界面语言：中文
- 场景：会话内 evolve 功能扩展对话框 → 自定义 JSON 与修改范围 → 起始字段

### Additional Information

问题区域：Evolve 创建对话框 →「起始字段」区块，右上角依次为「生成起始字段」与「上传 JSON」；下方提示为「先在会话输入框写下任务，即可生成起始字段。」与空态文案「根据任务生成起始字段、导入文件，或直接添加字段。」。点击「生成起始字段」时按钮外观、悬停光标与可用态完全一致，但没有任何响应。

### Version Information

- 版本：0.3.0 日包（daily build）
- 构建时间：2026-11-11T00:15:34Z（安装目录 resources/version.json 的 builtAt，其中 repoCommit 为 unknown）
- 安装方式：Windows x64 安装包，安装于 D:\software\sd\ScienceDiscovery

## 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

Split out of #1072 while fixing it in #1074. #1074 covers that issue's stated expectation — a panel stops polling a project/session the API reports as gone — and closes #1072. This issue is the **other 404 in the same trace**, which #1074 does not claim to fix.

The failed case (`test/agent-run-componentization.spec.ts` › `S2b`, run `42907916462`) recorded **two** `research-package/preview` 404s, and their bodies differ:

| time (UTC) | body | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 21:51:21.978 | `{"error":"File not found"}` | **this issue** — arrives *before* the project is deleted |
| 21:51:35.966 | `{"code":"EXPORT_PREVIEW_RESOURCE_DELETED"}` | the deletion case, handled by #1074 |

The first one is produced by the generic `ENOENT → 404 "File not found"` mapping at `services/api/src/http/index.ts:4559`, i.e. some read inside the preview threw `ENOENT` while the Project and Session still existed. The browser logs it as a resource error, and the journey's `no console/page errors expected` assertion counts it.

**What is not established.** Which read raised that `ENOENT` is **not** known. I did not trace it, and the preview path touches several stores (messages, runs, run streams, trajectory details, CAS objects, workspace files). This issue is filed as a report with the evidence that exists, not with a diagnosed cause.

**Why it matters.** Any preview that races a file the run is still publishing turns into a console error in a `@mocked` journey, which reds `L2 E2E (mocked, standard-journeys)` on its own. #1074 makes the *gone* answer quiet; it does not make an `ENOENT` on a live scope quiet.

## Expected

Either the read that throws is identified and its missing file is published (or waited for) before the preview answers, or the preview maps that specific transient `ENOENT` to the existing `409 EXPORT_PREVIEW_PENDING` contract instead of a 404, so a retry is what a client sees rather than a resource error. Which of the two is right depends on naming the read, so that comes first.

## Additional Information

- Repository `openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery`, `main` at `4bb737c2` when the run happened.
- Artifact: `mocked-e2e-results-standard-journeys` (id 13807782121); job `L2 E2E (mocked, standard-journeys)` (id 130151439627) on run [42907916462](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/actions/runs/42907916462).
- Related: #1072 (the teardown-poll half, fixed in #1074), #1085 (the preview-warming OOM, fixed in #1086).

## Version Information

- `main` @ `4bb737c2fccc8b55471dfd08f4f58754c5981cb3`
- Stack for the failing job: adapter 4410 → Node API 4510, runner 4411, memory-graph 17774; no real model calls.
